balls.text: low full toss on the wide guideline, slapped to mid-off for a single to end the innings.

slower bouncer on the wide guideline, Rashid flat bats this down the ground to long-on. They turn back initially for two before Tewatia decides he wants the strike for the final ball of the innings. Relay from Buttler comes in to Sandeep with Rashid stretching to get his bat back across the line. It's extremely tight. Will not matter in terms of a run or not since it's at the non-striker's end after one was completed. All that matters here is Rashid's average having another dismissal calculated into it or not. Plenty of time being used on this... Third umpire says Rashid is out. Hmmm... looked like he was in to me but it matters not.

goes for wide yorker and it turns into a shin high full toss on the guideline at 129 kph, Miller slices a thick edge trying to flay this over point and it skies to Hetmyer on the cover boundary where a catch is taken three yards inside the rope at chest height.
another wide yorker at 124 kph, Miller remains stationary this time and slices a toe edge between the keeper and short third to the rope.

another wide yorker on the guideline at 124 kph, this time Miller shuffles back deep in his crease to create space to get under this changing the length into a half-volley and carves a drive over extra cover to the rope wide of the sweeper.
wide yorker comes just inside the guideline, goes to drive and can't get bat on it.
sprays a wide yorker almost off the pitch outside the wide guideline, Miller can't reach this. Extra called.

fullish length on sixth stump, Manohar tries to heave another drive over the leg side but the spin produces a top edge tailing toward cover on the ring. Simple catch for Padikkal taking a few steps back from the edge of the circle at head height.
flighted full on leg stump, Manohar reaches for the nine-iron in his golf bag and chips this 89 meters over long-on into the 20th row.
short on fourth stump again, shuffles far across his stumps and almost cramps himself for room pulling this along the ground to long-on for one.
short on fourth stump, Miller rocks back quickly onto the back foot to lace a pull over wide midwicket, one bounce over the rope.
full on fifth stump, driven firmly to long-off for one.
good length ball on middle, hustles Manohar trying to punch this off the back foot, goes back to Zampa for none.
full on leg stump, clears the front leg to punch this in the air well short of long-on for one.
slower bouncer on the body at 113 kph, turtles his head to flick hook this along the ground at deep backward square leg, Padikkal slides to keep this to two.
shin high full toss going for a wide yorker on seventh stump, plenty of forearm muscle from Manohar clubbing this flat over the long-off rope.
134 kph length ball on off stump, muscles a pull shot off the front foot that lands in the third row over long-on.
attempted yorker is a low full toss at shin height on off at 134 kph, punched to long-on for one.
short on middle, pulled to deep square leg for one.
flighted full and wide just inside the guideline, Miller shuffles across and winds up to clobber this over deep midwicket landing in the eighth row.
short on the wide guideline, slaps this wide of the cover sweeper and they take on a sharp second.
back of a length on fifth stump, slices a cut to backward point, diving stop on the ring keeps this to one.
short outside leg, pulled to deep backward square leg for one.
full on the legs, flicked through backward square leg for one.
short and wide, goes to cut and toe edges this wide of the keeper backspinning to short third, diving stop on the ring keeps this to one.
full on fifth stump, punched to long-off for one.
full on off, punched to long-off for one.
fullish length ball on leg stump, flicked into deep midwicket for one.
good length ball on off, prodded down the ground to long-off for one.

full on fifth stump, Gill pumps a drive firmly down the ground toward long-off but doesn't get the elevation and rocks his head back immediately in frustration seeing that he's picked out Buttler 10 yards in from the rope. Simple catch taken at thigh height.
length ball on fifth stump, cross-bat swats this to long-on, tumbling stop along the rope by Boult keeps this to two.
back of a length on sixth stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
short on seventh stump, slapped to extra cover, knocked down by Jaiswal to keep it to one.
full outside leg, flicked through wide midwicket for two.

nearly a superman catch by Buttler at long-off! Full on off, Miller charges and slams a flat drive straight down the ground, Buttler covers 15 yards charging right before flinging himself airborne but the ball screams just past his reach and thuds into the LCD ad boards.
short on middle and leg, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
good length ball on middle, shuffles across and flicks through midwicket for one.
full on middle, flicked through midwicket for one.
full outside the wide guideline trying to get a stumping seeing Gull charging down the pitch, but Gill one-hand slaps this to long-off for one.
back of a length on middle, goes back to punch to wide long-on for one.
full outside leg, misses a flick and is fetched by short fine leg for a leg bye.
full on the legs, sweeps this firmly to deep backward square leg for one.
full on middle, Miller backs away and punches to extra cover for none.
full on the legs, goes to sweep and misses.
full on middle, charges and punches back to Zampa for none.
Miller uses his feet to a good length ball on the legs flicking through midwicket for one.
googly lands full on fourth stump, punched to extra cover for none.

dropped! Sitter put down by Zampa! Fullish length on fourth stump, Miller flicks across the line and a leading edge comes back to Zampa at head height. But his body is terribly balanced shuffling sideways and he snatches at it to the left of his face while falling sideways instead of having a stable base and shells this. He turned a 5/10 difficulty into an 8/10 difficulty with his poor balance and body positioning.
short on the legs, pulls through midwicket for one.
back of a length on off, flicked through vacant square leg for a very tight two.
good length ball on the legs, flicked through midwicket for one.
full on middle and leg, flicked into midwicket for one.

nearly chops on! Carrom ball skids on from fifth stump line and Miller chops a cut into the ground... or was it off his shoe? Appeal for a catch as the ricochet goes to slip. Third umpire replays indicate fairly obviously that it came off the shoe... but then onto the ground as well before carrying to slip. Not out.
back of a length on the stumps, flicked through midwicket for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, goes back to punch into the covers for one.
good length ball on the stumps, punched to long-on for one.
flighted more on a good length on off, tap and run into the covers for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, prodded into the covers for one.

full on off, Hardik goes to heave this over long-on but the leg break spins away enough to produce a top-edge swirling over extra cover. Jaiswal is having a torrid time getting his body into the right position backpedaling from the ring while fighting with the ball's swirling trajectory but gets his chest behind the ball at the last moment to hold onto a chance that looked like it was trying to burst back out of his hands.
good length ball angled down the leg side, wide called.
full on middle, flicked to wide midwicket for one.
full on the stumps, charges and drives to long-on for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, pull through wide midwicket for two.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched into the covers for one.
138 kph short ball on fourth stump, pulls this through square leg to the rope.
length ball on off, cross-bat swatted to long-on for one.
good length ball on middle, punched into the ground and the hard bounce off the pitch goes over Boult's leaping effort to long-on for one.
full and angled into off, punched through cover for one.
full on middle and off, stroked to long-off for one.
back of a length on middle, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
good length ball on off, defended to backward point.

good length on fifth stump, cuts this behind point for what should be two but they capitalize taking a third seeing that Hetmyer has stumbled along the rope after covering 20 yards running to his left at cover sweeper to field.
good length ball on fourth stump, Hardik goes to cut and chops a bottom edge into the ground bouncing past Samson for one.
good length ball on middle, defended to backward point.
flighted a touch on fifth stump landing full, Gill shuffles down the track and slaughters a lofted drive over long-on sailing over the sightscreen.
back of a length on fifth stump, slaps through extra cover to the sweeper for one.
full and wide on seventh stump, slices a drive off the toe and backspins away to the third man rope.
good length ball on the legs, flicked into midwicket for one.
Gill charges a fullish length ball on sixth stump and powers a flat drive over extra cover skidding to the rope.
full on the stumps, driven down the ground for one.
full on the legs, flicked down the ground to long-on for one.
full on fifth stump, prodded through point for one.
good length ball on off, tapped gently into the covers for one.
full again on fifth stump, muscles another drive high over Zampa to the mid-off rope.
full again, but this time Hardik winds up and powers this over the long-on rope.
full on the stumps, defended.
full on fifth stump, Gill charges and plays an elegant lofted drive over mid-off to the rope.
full on the legs, flicked to mid-on for one.
good length on middle, punched down the ground for one.
back of a length on off, defended.
back of a length on the legs, flicked through midwicket for one.
full on fifth stump, Gill sweeps this firmly behind square leg to the ripe.

dropped! And a near runout chance! In fact, not just a chance but a wicket! Charges a full ball on middle and tries to drive this over Zampa, but a tremendous athletic effort from the bowler leaping up one-handed knocks this toward mid-off. The batters try to take a single off the palmed effort but Buttler is extremely alert reacting to the carom coming his way, charges forward to collect one-handed and fires a bullet on one bounce to Samson, who breaks the stumps with Sudharsan just short stretching for the single. Replays indicate though that Sudharsan was slowed down and potentially obstructed by Zampa struggling to run around him when leaving from the non-striker's end after the ball was deflected toward Buttler and cost him crucial distance trying to make the ground.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.
full outside leg, flicks this to square leg for none.
back of a length on middle, goes back to flick through wide long-on for one.
good length ball on off, flicked into vacant midwicket for one.
good length ball on middle, pulled through midwicket for one.
full on the stumps, chipped gently into midwicket for one.
126 kph full on middle, flicked uppishly to long-on for one.
good length ball on the hips, flicked behind square leg for one.
back of a length on off, defended to mid-off.
full on middle, punched firmly to mid-on for none.
full on fourth stump, punched to mid-off for none.
length ball on the wide guideline at 135 kph, Gill spanks this on the up through extra cover and it skittles away to the rope.

nearly a catch at midwicket! Fullish length on off stump, flicked just wide of the fielder moving left and lunging in vain before having to get back to his feet and chase this ball down at the longest boundary in the ground keeping it to three.
134 kph ball full on seventh stump, punched firmly to extra cover for none.
good length ball on fifth stump at 131 kph, guided to cover for none.

full and swinging into the legs, flicks this off an inside edge and off the pads down the leg side for two to fine leg. Third umpire signals down on replay that Sudharsan didn't ground his bat past the line at the non-striker's end so has cost himself a run with one called short.
full on fifth stump swinging away, Sudharsan goes to punch through mid-off but it comes off more of the inner half of the bat and still has enough juice to bounce past Gill to the mid-on rope.
fullish length ball tailing down leg at 131 kph, wide called.
back of a length on fifth stump, defended to backward point.
full on fifth stump, defended to mid-off.
good length on fourth stump, punched to mid-off and they scamper a tight single.
back of a length on fifth stump, sliced behind point to the rope.
back of a length on middle and leg, defended to midwicket.
good length ball on middle, defended.
back of a length on middle, defended to Boult.
back of a length on middle, defended to midwicket.
full on the stumps, flicked straight to midwicket for none.

chaos from a skier ends with an improbable caught and bowled!  Fullish length on middle and leg, Saha goes to whip this over square leg but is through the shot a touch early and skies this straight up over the pitch. Samson charges forward from behind the stumps, Hetmyer charges in from square leg, another fielder (Dhruv Jurel) charges in from point. None of them want to defer and all three go for the catch. Samson gets his gloves to it and collides with Hetmyer with the ball popping out of the gloves up into the air.... But Boult was alert to the impending calamity and positioned himself a few yards behind the triangle collision readying himself for a possible rebound, holding on to the carom that pops toward him while reaching forward at knee height. Tremendous awareness from Boult to be prepared for the eventuality that occurred instead of standing around with hands on hips.
goes for the inswinging yorker at 135 kph but winds up as a shin high full toss flicked effortlessly over midwicket to the rope.
better from Boult. Good length ball swinging in on fourth stump at 135 kph, prod from Saha inside the line and is beaten.
good length ball tailing down the leg side, diving stop by Samson, wide called.

Hetmyer seals an improbable comeback in this chase for the Royals bashing this over wide midwicket into the LCD ad boards! Too short from Noor on fifth stump, Hetmyer picks the length early and rocks back and across to crush this pull flat over the leg side rope.
short and wide on seventh stump, cuts this wide of Rashid at cover sweeper who relays in for two but Hetmyer has a 25-ball half-century.
142 kph yorker speared in full following Boult backing away from leg stump and he plays over the top of this with a leg side heave.

slower ball at 127 kph lands as a half-volley on seventh stump, Ashwin checks his shot trying to just open his wrists guiding this behind point but is not in control of this and it floats off a thick edge to Tewatia at head height on the ring at backward point.
134 kph delivery lands short on fourth stump, sits up for Ashwin to swat a pull shot with disdain over wide midwicket bouncing into the base of the LCD ad boards.
short and wide, sits up for Ashwin to clatter a cut shot behind point elegantly picking the gap wide of the sweeper to the rope.

short on the stumps at 141 kph, goes to pull and a top edge swirls behind the keeper. Deep fine leg fielder Mohit Sharma charges 20 yards to his right, and nearly overruns the ball, before stopping his momentum and reaching back left across his body to take an adventurous catch at waist height five yards inside the rope.
in the slot on fifth stump, creams a drive high and deep over long-on landing in the sightscreen padding.
short on seventh stump, punches this wide of the sweeper for two.
Hetmyer charges a full ball outside leg stump and smokes a drive flat over long-on landing in the seventh row adjacent to the sightscreen.
googly flighted full outside leg, Hetmyer goes to slog sweep and misses before being hit in the ribs.
short outside leg, Hetmyer shuffles across and pulls this very fine behind square leg to the fine leg rope.
googly lands short on sixth stump, punched to extra cover for none.
googly lands too short spinning into the body, miscued pull goes behind square leg for one.
full on fourth stump, shovels a drive to long-off for one.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to deep square leg for one.
good length ball spins wide of the off stump guideline out of reach of a cut, wide called.

short on the body, goes to pull and flubs this off the gloves wide of short fine leg. The fielder collects on one bounce and fires to Saha. A direct hit would've had Hetmyer out but the relay into the gloves keeps the door ajar long enough for Hetmyer to stretch his bat across the line.
good length ball angled across eighth stump, goes to cut and misses.
full on the legs, goes to sweep and misses off the pads.
full floated wide on the wide guideline, drive by Jurel comes off a thick edge backspinning behind point and beats Rashid's sliding effort along the rope running across from cover sweeper.
full in the slot on sixth stump, Hetmyer annihilates this with a drive 25 rows back over long-on.
146 kph short ball on the body, pulled behind square leg for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, Jurel goes to defend and tries to pull the bat back late, it clips a thick edge going wide of the keeper to the rope.
length ball on the body, inside edges this off the body into square leg for one.

missed chance! Full toss at rib height. Hetmyer swivels out of the way before putting his bat up defensively for protection and it clips the top edge flying toward deep third man. Shami bizarrely sidesteps out of the way of this and it bounces just over the rope for six. It was signaled as a no ball for being above waist height on field but Hardik calls for a review and the third umpire says this ball was dipping low enough to be deemed legal. That makes Shami's actions at deep third man all the more strange. Effectively a missed chance. It barely landed over the rope and should have been a chest height catch.
full on fourth stump, heaves this flat toward Miller at long-on, charges 15 yards to his left and dives left to keep this to two runs.

maiden IPL wicket for Noor Ahmad! Flighted full on sixth stump, Samson goes for another almighty heave but doesn't come close to middling this one and it is skied off the toe well short of the long-off rope. Miller charges in 20 yards and takes a sliding catch at knee height about 10 yards short of the 30-yard ring at mid-off.
full and sprayed way outside leg, could've been five wides had Samson left it alone but he swats a pull off the toe topspinning past short fine leg to the rope.
flighted full and dragged wider on eighth stump, Samson spanks this drive high over wide long-off, not quite middled and still lands adjacent to the dugout beyond the rope.
full on fifth stump, flicked through midwicket for one.
flighted full on fifth stump, tapped into extra cover for one to bring up a 29-ball half-century. 19th IPL fifty to go along with 3 centuries.
back of a length on off stump, goes back to flick through wide midwicket for one.
yorker on middle and off at 143 kph, jammed out into mid-off for one.
short on the stumps, pulled through midwicket for two. 100 up for Rajasthan.
knee high full toss on middle, Hetmyer clubs this over backward square leg, one bounce over the rope.
length ball on seventh stump, slapped to long-on for one.
full on the legs, flicked to long-on for one.

length ball on the body, heaves this over deep backward square leg. The fielder cheated in 10 yards, Abhinav Manohar, and then struggled backpedaling before leaping in vain trying to keep this inside play. Even if he was on the rope though, it's unlikely he would've gotten a hand to it.
full on the legs, flicked through midwicket for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, punched through cover to the sweeper for one.
hat-trick for Samson! Too short again by Rashid, this time wider on sixth stump, Samson is still able to muscle a pull dragging this deeper over midwicket landing in the fifth row.
Rashid overcorrects too short on middle, Samson picks the length early and rocks back to heave a pull over deep midwicket, barely clearing the fielder leaping up in front of the rope once more.
full on sixth stump, drives this sweetly barely clearing Miller's leaping effort at long-off.
good length ball on fifth stump, goes back to defend to Rashid.
length ball on sixth stump, slapped along the ground to long-off for one.
back of a length on off, flicked through midwicket for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
length ball on middle, Hetmyer pulls out of a flick to this 131 kph delivery and skies this top edge into vacant midwicket in the ring. It lands safely well short of the boundary fielder charging in.
good length ball on fifth stump at 135 kph, punched to extra cover for none.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended to extra cover for none.
googly lands short on middle, Samson rocks back picking this early and clubs a pull a mile high over midwicket and lands in the 20th row.
good length legbreak on off stump, goes back to punch to long-off for one.
googly on middle spins away toward slip, goes back to defend.

goes for the orthodox legbreak full on fifth stump, goes to drive down the ground and it comes off the outer half of the bat. Miller reads it very well off the bat and charges in off the rope taking a catch diving forward at knee height.
back of a length googly on off spins into the legs, goes back to flick into vacant midwicket for one.
googly lands short on fourth stump coming in toward middle, flicked through square leg for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes back to punch to wide long-on for one.
128 kph good length ball on middle, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended to mid-off for none.
136 kph back of a length on fourth stump, punched to mid-off for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched uppishly through cover for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, goes to chop this through cover and misses.
short on middle, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
googly lands short on fourth stump and comes in toward middle, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
good length ball googly spins in from fifth stump and is flicked through midwicket for one.

charges a fullish length ball outside leg, but it's the googly spinning away and Padikkal doesn't get to the pitch. His heave for midwicket produces a thick edge swirling to short third man on the ring. Basic catch taken by Mohit Sharma at chest height.
full on the legs, defended tentatively back to Rashid for none.
good length on seventh stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on the hips, flicked through midwicket for one.
full on fifth stump, in the slot to drive with minimal fuss through the gap between extra cover and mid-off to the rope.

full and speared into middle and leg at 140 kph, massive lbw shout denied as Hardik beat Samson for pace flicking to midwicket. The ball caroms off the pads hitting Samson below the knee roll before going to point for none. This looked pretty dead live and Hardik wastes no time signaling for a DRS review once he sees it given not out.  Hardik doesn't give himself enough credit for the sharp inward movement he's produced this spell and ball-tracking shows it is missing leg stump. Review lost.
141 kph short on the stumps, pulled to deep square leg for one.
back of a length on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
good length ball on the legs at 139 kph, flicked to deep square leg for one.
back of a length on fifth stump at 141 kph, cuts this firmly to the cover sweeper for one.
147 kph ball lands on a fullish length angled across seventh stump, another sumptuous lofted extra cover drive, this time one bounce over the rope.
148 kph back of a length on off, tap and run for a sharp single to mid-on.
147 kph fullish length ball on the stumps, defended to mid-on for none.
length ball on the hips, swivel from Samson and smokes this 143 kph delivery pulling it high and deep over backward square leg landing in the 15th row.
back of a length on fifth stump at 143 kph, extra bounce beats a back foot punch and is collected by the keeper Saha above his head.
bouncer over middle at 143 kph, ducked under by Padikkal.
139 kph ball back of a length on middle, defended back to Hardik.

fullish length on sixth stump at 142 kph, Padikkal latches on to this drive and sends it screaming over extra cover and has plonked a female fan right in the head in the second row. It hit her on the bounce so hopefully it softened the blow.
good length ball follows Padikkal backing away from leg stump at 138 kph, defended to midwicket for none.
142 kph delivery lands short on fifth stump, pulled into the ground to midwicket for none.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended.

dropped at slip! 141 kph length ball on the wide guideline seaming away, Padikkal chases after this and gets a thick edge to Gill just above head height. Gill reaches up to his left with a slight bunny hop and it bursts through and he immediately shakes his right hand vigorously before flopping to the ground. The physio comes on and escorts him off quite quickly as Gill clutches at his thumb and forefinger on the right hand.

extraordinary shot considering the state of the Royals innings! Full on the legs, just a nonchalant flick to this half-volley that sails over deep backward square leg into the cage fencing in front of the first row of fans.
length ball on eighth stump at 135 kph, goes to cut and is beaten with the ball swinging away sharply.
length ball angled over off stump, Padikkal shuffles forward to heave over midwicket and misses.
back of a length on fifth stump at 140 kph, defended behind point.
back of a length on seventh stump at 139 kph, swipes at this and misses.
back of a length on seventh stump, guides this 140 kph delivery behind point to the rope.
bouncer on seventh stump at 142 kph, left alone.
good length ball seaming in sharply from sixth stump in toward off at 134 kph, defended firmly back to the bowler.
fullish length ball swinging away from sixth stump, Samson reaches out with a flat-footed drive and is beaten.
back of a length on fourth stump at 137 kph, plays this late to deep third man for one.
142 kph full outside leg shaping away toward the slips, but gets it too full on the legs and is flicked over midwicket and clears the infield bouncing away to the rope.
good length ball seaming in from fifth stump toward middle at 133 kph, defended to midwicket.

bullseye! Pressure bursts pipe! Buttler tries to break the shackles shuffling across his stumps to a 142 kph length delivery seaming in toward off stump and misses an attempted scoop over fine leg. Off stump is crushed three-quarters of the way up and ripped out of the ground.
139 kph back of a length on fifth stump, defended to point for none.
139 kph good length ball on middle, heaves to clear mid-on but misses and is hit in the thigh.
good length ball angled into the legs at 139 kph, goes back to flick and misses, comes off the pads into the off side and they scamper a tight run.
nearly a carbon copy of the Jaiswal dismissal. Padikkal pokes his bat away from the body trying to run this to third man and is beaten.
good length inswinger on middle and leg, flick across the line and a deflection goes to deep third man for one.
full and angled across sixth stump, Padikkal backs away trying to go inside out over cover but takes himself out of reach to play the shot.
good length ball on seventh stump at 134 kph, beats Padikkal prodding away.

absurd shot! Jaiswal opens the face to this 136 kph back of a length delivery on fifth stump and guides it straight to slip. Catching practice! Gill takes a basic catch at rib height reaching left across his body. That shot might have made sense with no slip in place but he was asking for trouble playing it in the second over.
back of a length on fifth stump at 138 kph, beats Jaiswal again this time off the back foot.
fullish length ball angled across fifth stump, beats Jaiswal driving.
back of a length on fifth stump at 139 kph, goes back to defend into midwicket.
fullish length ball seaming sharply into the legs at 143 kph beats Buttler going back and hits him in the thigh, stifled lbw shout. Missing leg.
length ball sits up on the stumps, pulls this tamely over wide mid-on landing in no man's land for one.
length ball on fifth stump, sliced straight to backward point fielded on a bounce for none.
140 kph delivery lands full on middle, punched to mid-on for none.
fullish length on eighth stump at 137 kph, goes to drive and is beaten by some late away seam movement.
bouncer wide outside off, called wide on the line.
